intent: Individually teach lift/elevator noun comparison without replacing lift verb,balconies,contextual gate,key-to gerund,lock noun/verb and direct object,bed under/go to bed,sofa on and chair versus seat. Purposeful original furniture-position picture buttons,neutral coded reference sets,eight own-form lists,original writing,changed rewrites and new capacity/key reading remain draft and credit free.
picturePurpose: Three original furniture panels support actual neutral panel buttons:cat under bed,cushion on sofa,chair beside table. Exact labels/answers stay in code. Occluded rear furniture legs are not counted. Sofa capacity in fresh reading is written evidence independent of image.

workshop.title: 找家具与位置，再把钥匙配对
workshop.instruction: 点场景或选判断，再填句子、换个细节写一句。最后按新通知安排座位和钥匙。

items.label: lift：先分电梯和抬起，再看英美用词
items.prompt: 读两句：The lift stops here. Please lift this box. 哪项分清了两个lift？

wordDecision.prompt: 读两句：The lift stops here. Please lift this box. 哪项分清了两个lift？

items.material: The lift stops at every floor.
items.reason: 英式名词lift对应美式elevator；动词“抬起”仍用lift，不能把动词也换成elevator。读句子时先分词性。
items.hint: 英式lift / 美式elevator：电梯；动词lift：抬起。

options.text: Both uses name a machine that carries people between floors.
options.reason: 第二句lift this box是抬起箱子，不是在给机器命名。

options.text: Both uses mean raise something with your hands.
options.reason: 第一句The lift是名词电梯，不是让人抬东西。

options.text: The first lift names a machine; the second means raise.
options.reason: 第一句有The，lift是电梯；第二句是请求，lift是抬起。

transfer.stem: Which plan follows the new reading-club notice?
transfer.passage:
READING CLUB — NEW ROOM PLAN
Our meeting is on the floor above the entrance. Use the lift if you need it. Please close the garden gate when you arrive. The blue key opens the cupboard; it does not open the back door. Ask Ms Lin for the back-door key. There are four separate chairs and a sofa with space for two people. Seven people are coming, and each person needs a seat. Bring one more chair. Keep the path to the door clear.

options.text: Bring one more chair and ask Ms Lin for the back-door key.
There are enough seats because four chairs and two sofa places make seven.
Use the blue key for the back door because every key opens every lock.
Leave the garden gate open because the notice asks visitors to close it.

answer.display: Bring one more chair and ask Ms Lin for the back-door key.

explanation.strategy: 先算座位，再核对钥匙对应的锁；不要用旧图替代新通知中的人数和容量。

steps.text: 四把椅子加沙发上的两个座位，共六个；七人还缺一个座位。
steps.reason: four separate chairs与space for two people给出4+2=6；Seven people说明还缺7−6=1。

steps.text: 蓝钥匙只开柜子；后门钥匙要向Ms Lin索取。
steps.reason: it does not open the back door排除蓝钥匙；下一句直接说明向谁拿后门钥匙。

distractors.reason: 4+2=6，不是7；把两处数量相加时算错了。
通知明确说蓝钥匙不能开后门，不能由“钥匙”推成所有锁都能开。
close是关上，不是保持打开；这项把动作倒过来了。

explanation.pitfall: chair是椅子，seat是座位；沙发容量以本次文字记录为准。钥匙与锁要按明确配对，不能任意替换。
